name: GoodLyfe Infused Pre-Roll | Blue Raspberry
description: Blue Raspberry is a balanced hybrid strain where the blue flavor will give you flashbacks of the fruity, blue treats you used to enjoy as a child. Blue Raspberry has a heavy berry, fruit flavor forward with a citrusy and an almost licorice aftertaste. Its dominant terpenes are D-Limonene and Myrcene.
